description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 02/2022 (Annual Liquor License Fees)
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns regulatory amendments to the Excise Ordinance, specifically adjusting annual liquor license fees and security deposits. It is issued by the Minister of Finance under statutory powers (Sections 25 and 32 of the Excise Ordinance) and rescinds a previous notification. The core content is the modification of a legal/regulatory framework governing commercial activities, which fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it names the Minister, it does so only in his capacity as the authority making the regulatory change and does not detail his ministerial portfolio responsibilities, preventing it from being classified as a government personnel type.
